-- Spark SQL that needs transpiling: backticks, IF, nvl, STRING and concat_ws, in the
-- entry and in the measures.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE size_bands AS
SELECT
  region, size_band,
  CONCAT_WS('-', `region`, CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING)) AS label, SUM(COALESCE(amount, 0)) AS total_amount
FROM (
  SELECT *, IF(nvl(amount, 0) >= 100, 'large', 'small') AS size_band
  FROM orders
) AS banded
GROUP BY region, size_band;
